run_parallelized_gif_generation: run the gif maker script with --traj-path and --out-path to generate animated gifs from trajectory files
run_pov_from_atoms: run pov_from_atoms to render a POV-Ray snapshot image from an ASE atoms object with bond pairs
run_parallelize_generation: run parallelize_generation to generate POV-Ray images and compile them into a GIF using ffmpeg in parallel
review_pov_from_atoms: review the pov_from_atoms function that separates organic adsorbate atoms from surface atoms and renders POV-Ray images
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that defines CLI arguments for traj-path, out-path, and num-workers
